(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS

No. 1891/31 – THURSDAY, DECEMBER 04, 2014
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS
AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT No. 28 OF 1964 Notice under Section 07
My No.: L4/Daduru Oya/Acquisition/Volume 4.
Your No.: LD/05/2010/IR/83.

I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, of 28 of 1964, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act that the Government intends to acquire the following Lands/servitudes which are required for a public purpose.

Description of the land/Servitude to be acquired: 160 (Hundred and sixty) allotments of land mentioned in the below list by the names, extents and in total extents about 10.5776 Hectares, in Final Village Plan No. 3104, Sheet No. 02, Supplement No. 02 in Final Village Plan 2959, Sheet No. 03, Supplement No. 01, in Final Village Plan 1988 Sheet No. 05, Supplement No. 04, dated 30.08.2014 and 30.09.2014 and 22.10.2014 prepared by the Surveyor General and situated at the villages of Mawathagama, Weraharakotuwa, Wadupolawa, Dalukgolla and Bogollagama in the Minor Division of Magulothota Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Nikaweratiya in the District of Kurunegala in North Western Province.
